claims.disproof_condition: 條件：仕佳之後的定期報告、上交所公告或問詢回復寫出 100mW CW DFB 出貨下滑、客戶取消或延後訂單，或 CW 雷射晶片及 COC 募投項目延後、縮減或終止。核查頻率：每季（仕佳定期報告與上交所公告）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊 confidence，重讀 CW DFB 雷射層的供給側讀法（新增產能與商用供應商家數）。
claims.statement: Shijia Photons (688313.SS) SSE inquiry reply 2026-10-24: its 100mW CW DFB laser chips (for 400G/800G/1.6T silicon-photonics modules) have shipped in volume to multiple leading international optical-module makers since June 2026, with several customers placing volume orders that lock next year's delivery; as of 2026-10-12 it has ample backlog and framework agreements for 100mW, and small-volume orders for 400mW CW DFB COC (for CPO external light sources). Its equity-raise project for CW laser chips and COC has a 3-year build and RMB 1.456B total investment; no unit capacity is stated. Supplier self-report; customers are not named.
